title: Meta to deploy up to 6 GW of AMD Instinct GPUs

sources.quote: AMD and Meta agree to a definitive multi-year, multi-generation partnership to deploy up to 6 gigawatts of AMD Instinct™ GPUs

As part of the agreement, to further align strategic interests, AMD has issued Meta a performance-based warrant for up to 160 million shares of AMD common stock, structured to vest as specific milestones associated with Instinct GPU shipments are achieved.

explain: Meta signed a definitive deal to buy AMD AI chips worth up to 6 gigawatts of capacity, starting with 1 gigawatt in late 2026. AMD gave Meta a warrant for up to 160 million AMD shares that vests as shipments happen. AMD gave no dollar figure; press reports ranged from about $60B to over $100B.
